verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents composing repeatable multi-step workflows: a drag-and-drop block builder with shareable templates, agents that can be edited in Studio, scheduled and shared, and cached Playwright code so repeat runs are deterministic. This clearly goes beyond one-shot prompts, but none of the evidence mentions loops, conditional branching or workflow parameters, which are the specific constructs the story asks for. missing for 10: documented loop blocks, conditional/branching logic, workflow input parameters, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow composition.
